description: Defines the MidiService class responsible for managing MIDI backends, sessions, and data transmission within the Chromium media MIDI module.

classes.name: MidiService
classes.description: Manages MIDI backends, sessions, and data transmission, designed to be constructed on the main thread and used across main and I/O threads.

classes.name: MidiService::ManagerFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating MidiManager instances, allowing for customized backend creation, primarily used for testing.

methods.name: TimestampToTimeDeltaDelay
methods.description: Converts Web MIDI timestamp to base::TimeDelta delay for scheduling.

methods.name: MidiService(std::unique_ptr<ManagerFactory>)
methods.description: Constructor allowing injection of a custom ManagerFactory, useful for testing.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Prepares the service for shutdown, called on the main thread.

methods.name: StartSession
methods.description: Begins a MIDI session for a client.

methods.name: EndSession
methods.description: Ends a MIDI session for a client, returns false if the client was not in a session.

methods.name: DispatchSendMidiData
methods.description: Sends MIDI data to a specified port with a timestamp.

methods.name: GetTaskRunner
methods.description: Returns a task runner for scheduling MIDI tasks, identified by runner_id.

methods.name: task_service
methods.description: Returns the TaskService associated with this MidiService.
